task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate to the CUP, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE, and place the CUP on it.
assumptions: Navigating near the object (tolerance 0.5) will place the robot within interaction distance.
The coordinates for CUP and TABLE can be safely approximated.
Place action uses the TABLE's name as location_name.
rtdl: def task PickAndPlace(;){ state nav_s: bool; state nav_m: string; state pick_s: bool; state pick_m: string; state place_s: bool; state place_m: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav_s, message->nav_m); check(nav_s == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP"; success->pick_s, message->pick_m); check(pick_s == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=-2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav_s, message->nav_m); check(nav_s == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP", location_name="TABLE"; success->place_s, message->place_m); check(place_s == true); } }
